dream.en: Hold on to your dream — it shines on dark days.
dream.cn: 守住梦想——它在黑暗的日子里闪光。

job.en: Choose a job that you really love.
job.cn: 选一份你真正热爱的工作。

doctor.en: A good doctor saves many lives every year.
doctor.cn: 好医生每年挽救许多生命。

teacher.en: Teachers light the way for the young generation.
teacher.cn: 老师为年轻一代点亮道路。

engineer.en: Engineers design the tall buildings we live in.
engineer.cn: 工程师设计我们居住的高楼。

scientist.en: Scientists try to find answers to the big questions.
scientist.cn: 科学家努力寻找重大问题的答案。

writer.en: A writer can take readers to other worlds.
writer.cn: 作家能把读者带去别的世界。

work hard.en: If you work hard, your dream will come true one day.
work hard.cn: 努力下去，梦想终有一天会实现。
